parent.p38_visible_cue_rule: a=sign(goal_direction*visible_cue) is optimal without learning on P38 source

hypothesis: Factual action- and analog-context-keyed bounded residual memory improves cold retention and learned action-consequence prediction after unrelated intervening experiences, without granting false future-outcome knowledge.

candidate.memory: read-before-write bounded actual-action keyed continuous sensor residual cache
candidate.status_limit: Engineering scaffolding; fixed episodic keys do not establish learned causal abstraction, long-horizon reasoning or transfer
candidate.known_limitation: Identical current visible sensor/action histories from opposite unobserved modes can produce cancelling stored residuals; P39 fixed-key cache alone cannot infer latent mode.

next_scientific_trial.pass_rule: Only a separately prospectively frozen source, thresholds, matched fully trained controls and independent source-owner qualification may establish scientific PASS. Do not retune P38-R1 post-result.
next_scientific_trial.partial_observability: At least two source dynamical modes must share the same current observable sensors and actions; only prior factual observations may reveal mode; prohibit fixed same-state cue or goal-sign shortcut.
next_scientific_trial.interference_test: Reversal and recurrence of hidden modes after distracting intervening actions; score both cold retention and current-mode identification.
next_scientific_trial.baseline_requirement: Zero-training policies, history-blind lookup, context-only fixed memory, fully trained MLP and GRU, matched-action-information sham and disabled-memory; count full compute and data.
